title: Interpret the interval

choices: 95% of the 500 sampled salaries are in this interval
There is a 95% chance the population median is in this particular interval
We are 95% confident the population median salary is between 104,300 and 115,600
explanations: The CI is about the median, not individual salaries.
The interval estimates a parameter, not where the data lie.
The parameter is fixed; the 95% describes the method over many samples.

solution: The CI estimates the population median; '95% confidence' means the procedure captures the parameter in about 95% of samples.
